note: At 2:55 (the last 5 s of w6 into w7) the guitarists come together for one four-cell phrase and four cells of the negative; the melody returns twice as fast, then at its original pace. The last beat is left free for the cadence.

1:32.5–2:00: the bass anticipates the three missing pitches at the end of each third cell. The clean chord shortens as the phrase fills; at 1:53.125 the bass gets its first complete E♭–C–A♭–F without another attack. No faders moved.
